answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose the task of simulating NL feedback for interactive semantic parsing... a feedback simulator aims to produce a feedback sentence F that is similar to how humans give corrective instructions to the semantic parser.
answer_1.outputs: NL feedback sentences (F) describing errors and corrections

answer_2.quote: We conducted two evaluations comparing our evaluator with the existing metrics, BLEU and BERTScore. For automatic evaluation, we report the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of each evaluation metric when it is used to rank the positive feedback among the 50 negative ones on the SPLASH dev set.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation and instructed human participants to rank among feedback generated by different simulators under the same context. We also used a 5-level Likert Scale to assess feedback quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters ranked feedback from different simulators and rated each on a 5‑level Likert scale.
